---
title: "Week 8: Exploratory Data Analysis"
---

## Official Topic

Exploratory data analysis.

## Problem Focus

How do we generate useful questions from data without fooling ourselves?

Students use variation, covariation, visualization, and transformation to discover patterns and data-quality problems.

## In Class

- Separate variable types.
- Visualize distributions.
- Investigate relationships between variables.
- Record questions, findings, and doubts.

## AI-Aware Task

Ask an LLM to summarize a plot. Decide whether it overclaims, ignores uncertainty, or misses data-quality issues.
